using System;
using System.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Tsavorite.Tests
{
    public class TsavoriteKVLoggerTests<TKey, TValue, TStoreFunctions, TAllocator> 
        where TStoreFunctions : struct, IStoreFunctions<TKey, TValue>
        where TAllocator : AllocatorBase<TKey, TValue, TStoreFunctions, TAllocator>
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_WhenCheckpointDirAndCheckpointManagerBothSpecified_LogsInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock
                .Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var kvSettings = new KVSettings<TKey, TValue>()
            {
                LoggerFactory = loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                CheckpointSettings = new CheckpointSettings()
                {
                    CheckpointDir = "some/dir",
                    CheckpointManager = new Mock<ICheckpointManager>().Object
                }
            };

            var storeFunctions = default(TStoreFunctions);
            Func<AllocatorSettings, TStoreFunctions, TAllocator> allocatorFactory = 
                (_, __) => throw new NotImplementedException(); // Won't be called due to exception before

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<Exception>(() => 
                new TsavoriteKV<TKey, TValue, TStoreFunctions, TAllocator>(kvSettings, storeFunctions, allocatorFactory));

            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("CheckpointManager and CheckpointDir specified, ignoring CheckpointDir")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_WhenCheckpointDirNullAndCheckpointManagerNull_DoesNotLogInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock
                .Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var kvSettings = new KVSettings<TKey, TValue>()
            {
                LoggerFactory = loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                CheckpointSettings = new CheckpointSettings()
            };

            var storeFunctions = default(TStoreFunctions);
            Func<AllocatorSettings, TStoreFunctions, TAllocator> allocatorFactory = 
                (_, __) => throw new NotImplementedException();

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<Exception>(() => 
                new TsavoriteKV<TKey, TValue, TStoreFunctions, TAllocator>(kvSettings, storeFunctions, allocatorFactory));

            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("CheckpointManager and CheckpointDir specified")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
